raw:
@q query
  select ?fee
  where match
    relation "be the monthly fee at"
    role subject "Revolut Business"
    role object ?fee
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "apply to"
  role subject ?fee
  role object "a PFA with under 100 transactions per month"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation
